name: Randi
source:
In a world that grows more artificial each day, one man starts to notice the cracks. A cryptic crossword and a loyal friend push him toward a terrifying question – what if we're losing what makes us real?

[From [url=https://sozochka.itch.io/randi]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个日益人造化的世界里，一个人开始注意到其中的裂缝。一个神秘的填字游戏和一个忠实的朋友将他推向一个可怕的问题——如果我们失去了让我们真实的东西怎么办？

[来自[url=https://sozochka.itch.io/randi]Itch.io[/url]]
